structuralChecks.semanticGrading: Manual source/schema comparison, not lexical assertions

restoration.warning: Rejected published experiment versions remain immutable history in the internal canary control plane. Do not apply latest blindly; native prompt is restored to ver-21e8391f.

recommendedNextScopeNotImplemented: Review self-sufficient INFORMATION handling and the meaning of ANSWER_FROM_CONTEXT under RAG_IF_ACTIONS_INSUFFICIENT. Preserve pending-confirmation, live-fact freshness and actual retrieval authority checks; do not blindly bypass planning whenever directAnswer is present.
Treat public workflow documentation and execution permission as separate concerns; never make authenticated actions anonymous merely to expose explanatory fields.
Prefer a single scoped, provenance-preserving workflow reference through the relevant model stages over duplicated unstructured schema text. Exact implementation needs review before code changes.
Keep partial-compound synthesis, global alternative completeness and source enrichment separate; do not silently add them to a framework release.

sourceInspection.IntentHandlingStep: Calls read resolution before returning directAnswer; an attempted resolution may promote the turn to retrieval/generation.
sourceInspection.ReadActionResolutionService.shouldUseRag: Under the configured cooperation policy, ANSWER_FROM_CONTEXT can still request RAG when no successful read-action evidence exists.
sourceInspection.existingFreshnessRegression: shouldRunReadActionPlannerBeforeReturningInformationDirectAnswer deliberately protects live availability against an unsupported extraction-time answer. Any correction must retain that safety property.
sourceInspection.generation: Existing answer-generation prompt can carry explicit configuration facts, but this experiment did not give all model stages a single scoped typed workflow reference.
sourceInspection.traceLimit: Clarification responses do not expose every original extraction flag or full read-planner decision. Source confirms a possible promotion path; do not claim exact hidden decisions were captured for every failed turn.

limitations: Two bounded sequential prompt experiments, not statistical reliability, load testing, managed customer acceptance or production rollout. Failed results retained; no further prompt retry or unapproved code fix.
